invariants.description: carbon is conserved: 6 flux_glc + 3 flux_lac + flux_CO2 = 0 (glucose C6, lactate C3) (exact)
adenine nucleotides conserved: ATP + ADP = A_tot (exact)

first law: the enthalpy taken in with glucose minus that leaving with lactate equals the heat released plus the enthalpy stored in ATP: V h_ATP dATP + Q_met dt + (flux_glc h_glc + flux_lac h_lac) dt = 0 integrated over the run, with h_glc = 6 h_O2_ox = 2.82e+06 J/mol and h_lac = h_glc/2 - h_lac_gly = 1.347e+06 J/mol, relative to CO2, H2O and ADP + Pi (relative 1e-6 of the heat released)
invariants.expr: abs(V_c*h_ATP*(ATP[-1] - ATP[0]) + np.trapz(Q_met + flux_glc*6*h_O2_ox + flux_lac*(3*h_O2_ox - h_lac_gly), t)) <= 1e-6*np.trapz(np.abs(Q_met), t)

invariants.description: second law: every reaction runs forward (irreversible, far from equilibrium), r_ox, r_gly, r_dem >= 0
from depleted ATP (run_parameters ATP_init = 2 mM) ATP recovers to the calibrated steady state 3.152 mM by the end of the run (relative 1e-6)
